answer: In the OECD Recommendation on AI, the 'AI system lifecycle' refers to the typical phases that an AI system undergoes, which include planning and design, collecting and processing data, building and adapting models, testing, evaluating, verifying, validating, deploying, operating, monitoring, and retiring or decommissioning the system. These phases often occur in an iterative manner and are not necessarily sequential, meaning that decisions regarding the lifecycle can be made at various points throughout the process.
